top_findings: Missing security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options) in next.config.ts
Missing llms.txt and llms-full.txt files for AI Search / LLM crawler discovery
Preconnect to i.ytimg.com to optimize LCP on dynamic video thumbnail loading
Add HowTo structured schema for the 3-step download workflow to capture rich snippets
Explicitly configure AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) in robots.txt
quick_wins: Add security headers in next.config.ts (takes 5 mins)
Create public/llms.txt summarizing site tools for ChatGPT Search & Perplexity (takes 5 mins)
Add <link rel="preconnect" href="https://i.ytimg.com" /> in layout.tsx (takes 2 mins)
Add AggregateRating and HowTo schema in StructuredData.tsx (takes 10 mins)
Add MP4 vs WebM comparison guide on homepage to expand semantic keyword coverage (takes 15 mins)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Clean dynamic XML sitemap at /sitemap.xml with daily/weekly change frequencies
Proper robots.txt with disallow for /api/ and clear sitemap reference
Self-referencing canonical links on every page to prevent duplicate content
Zero crawl errors (all 7 core routes prerendered with HTTP 200 OK)
Mobile viewport tag configured properly

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security Headers
findings.description: next.config.ts does not send X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, or Referrer-Policy headers.
findings.recommendation: Add a headers() block in next.config.ts returning secure default headers.

findings.title: IndexNow Protocol Not Implemented
findings.description: Bing and Yandex IndexNow protocol is not integrated for instant URL notification upon release.
findings.recommendation: Add /api/indexnow endpoint or static API key file for instant indexing notification.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique, keyword-focused title tags within 50-60 character limits
Compelling meta descriptions for all pages satisfying user search intent
Single H1 tag per page hierarchy followed by structured H2/H3 headings
OpenGraph and Twitter Card metadata configured across all pages
Internal cross-linking between all downloader tools via Header, Footer, and RelatedTools

findings.title: Homepage Deep Content Expansion
findings.description: While tool pages have explanatory sections, homepage can benefit from a detailed format comparison section.
findings.recommendation: Add a comparison table on the homepage for video and audio formats.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Direct utility above-the-fold without intrusive ads, paywalls, or forced logins
Comprehensive, tool-specific FAQ accordions answering common user questions
Dedicated transparency and trust pages (/privacy, /terms, /contact)
Clear copyright and trademark disclaimers acknowledging YouTube's trademarks

findings.title: Editorial Experience & Verification Signals
findings.description: Content lacks explicit author or testing team credentials (e.g., 'Tested by our media engineering team').
findings.recommendation: Add an about/engineering trust badge detailing yt-dlp version tracking and format verification.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: WebApplication schema with MultimediaApplication category and $0 free offer
Organization and WebSite schema integrated with official logo and contact point
BreadcrumbList schema on all pages
FAQPage schema correctly mirroring visible FAQs on each tool page
XSS protection escaping HTML characters in JSON-LD payloads

findings.title: HowTo Schema Opportunity
findings.description: The 3-step 'From URL to download in seconds' is prime candidate for Google HowTo rich snippets.
findings.recommendation: Add HowTo JSON-LD schema to StructuredData.tsx.

findings.title: AggregateRating on WebApplication
findings.description: WebApplication schema does not include user satisfaction rating.
findings.recommendation: Add aggregateRating object with ratingValue and reviewCount.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Turbopack-optimized static rendering with zero heavy runtime UI libraries
Next.js Inter font subsetting and Google Fonts preconnecting
Lazy loaded thumbnails and clean SVG icons
Clean client bundle with zero unnecessary dependencies

findings.title: Preconnect to YouTube Thumbnail CDN
findings.description: Dynamic thumbnails load from i.ytimg.com. Preconnecting reduces handshake latency.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel="preconnect" href="https://i.ytimg.com" /> to root layout.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: High information density with concise definitions, bullet points, and Q&A
Semantic HTML5 tags throughout layout (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <section>, <footer>)

findings.title: Missing llms.txt and llms-full.txt
findings.description: AI engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude) index llms.txt for structured tool understanding.
findings.recommendation: Create public/llms.txt and public/llms-full.txt with clear markdown documentation of all tools.

findings.title: Explicit AI Crawler Permissions
findings.description: robots.txt allows all crawlers via '*', but explicitly declaring GPTBot and ClaudeBot boosts crawl rate.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit allow rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot in robots.ts.

categories.name: Images & Assets
what_works: Standard multi-resolution icons (192x192, 512x512, apple-touch-icon)
site.webmanifest for PWA and mobile bookmarking
Dynamic alt tags on fetched video thumbnails

findings.title: High-Resolution OG Image
findings.description: Current og-image.png is basic. A dedicated 1200x630 banner improves CTR in social shares.
